items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, SEP 3 - A six-year-old boy who has been in a coma in an Egyptian hospital since an August 3 accident at a swimming pool at Sharm El Sheikh is currently being flown back to Italy, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on a visit to Cairo Thursday. items.title: Meloni govt to extend 17-cent cut in diesel duties to Sept 10
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 04 SET - The economy ministry has prepared a decree extending a 17-cent cut in diesel duties until September 10, sources said on Friday. The cut was first introduced by Premier Giorgia Meloni's government at the end of July to help people cope with high fuel costs following the return of conflict in the Persian Gulf and it has been renewed several times since. The current reduction was set to expire on Saturday. The cut, which does not regard unleaded petrol, has not stopped diesel prices from rising well above two euros a litre. The centre-left opposition has criticised the cut
items.titleIt: Meloni govt to extend 17-cent cut in diesel duties to Sept 10

items.title: IPI: Africa Media Freedom Monitoring: April to June 2026
items.description: The International Press Institute (IPI) recorded nearly 100 cases of threats and attacks on journalists (82 male and 18 female) across 22 countries in sub-Saharan Africa between April and June 2026. Physical and verbal attacks, as well as arrests and detention, were the most frequent types of incidents. An Ethiopian journalist in exile was found dead in Kenya under suspicious circumstances.   Police and state security forces (55%) continued to be the primary perpetrators of attacks and threats against journalists, a trend that continues from the previous quarter.
